MD - MD at Prediction Start: feet of hidden suffix already drilled. The primary uncertainty axis — error grows with it.
log(1 + dmd). Compresses the long tail so a linear model can express sub-linear error growth.
Z - Z at the last known TVT row. The observable vertical movement of the bit; TVT changes only where dz differs from the structural surface.
X - X at the last known TVT row.
Y - Y at the last known TVT row.
sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2): horizontal step-out from the prediction start. The lever arm on which structural dip acts.
dz / dmd: mean wellbore vertical gradient since the prediction start.
Locally smoothed dZ/dMD (51 ft window): instantaneous wellbore inclination relative to horizontal.
sin of the local trajectory azimuth. Combined with dip, azimuth sets the sign and magnitude of apparent dip along the hole.
cos of the local trajectory azimuth.
